story.body: You read the year at the head and the unreceived line. You capped the pen.

participation.context: Called the idleness obedience, refused Henslowe's book, and said a fortnight.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Said the three pounds, and would not round them.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Kept the stage empty, named the Mayor's count, and would not invent a fine.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Ralph Raye brought the bill, reported the flag, and refused a sum he did not see.

story.body: You kept the company on this side of the river. You let Kemp have the three pounds as his bitterness. You took Raye's witness as the flag, not a receipt. You said a fortnight, and you asked for no share of a day with no play.
